title: 「This is not to say that + clause」句
titleZh: 「This is not to say that + clause」表示「這並不是說……」
titleEn: This is not to say that + clause

source.file: Sentence Structure 253 - 「This is not to say that + clause」表示「這並不是說……」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than this system lesson ID because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: this is not to say that + complete clause

formulas.formula: Statement. This is not to say that + clause.
Statement; this is not to say that + clause.
Statement, but this is not to say that + clause.
Although / Even though + clause, this is not to say that + clause.
When + someone describes / says / argues / reports something, + this is not to say that + clause.
Statement — this is not to say that + clause.

example: Technology can sometimes cause problems. This is not to say that it is always harmful.
exampleZh: 科技有時會帶來問題。這並不是說科技總是有害。

meaning.zh: 在提出一個觀點後加以限制或澄清，說明前一句不應被過度推論為另一個更強、絕對或錯誤的意思。

rules.zh: 核心句型只是 this is not to say that + complete clause；其他連接語和標點屬於語境需要。
rules.en: The core structure is this is not to say that plus a complete clause. Other connectors and punctuation depend on the surrounding context.

rules.zh: 這個句型用來阻止別人從前一句作出過度推論。
rules.en: Use this structure to prevent an excessive inference from the preceding statement.

rules.zh: This 必須指向前面已經提出的觀點、意見、論點、建議、發現或描述。
rules.en: This must refer clearly to an idea, opinion, argument, recommendation, finding or description already introduced.

rules.zh: that 後面必須接主語和有限動詞構成的完整子句；不可省略 that。
rules.en: After that, use a complete clause with a subject and a finite verb. Retain the word that.

rules.zh: 核心句型可放在新句、分號、but、讓步子句、報告子句或破折號後。
rules.en: The core may follow a full stop, semicolon, but, a concession clause, a reporting clause or a dash.

rules.zh: 不要只用逗號直接連接兩個完整句，否則會造成 comma splice。
rules.en: Do not join two complete sentences with only a comma, because that creates a comma splice.

rules.zh: that 子句可按需要使用現在式、過去式、完成式、將來式或情態動詞。
rules.en: The that-clause may use present, past, perfect or future forms, or a modal verb, as required by the meaning.

rules.zh: 這個句型不一定表示相反觀點正確；它只是限制前一句可被理解的範圍。
rules.en: The structure does not necessarily assert that the opposite is true. It limits how far the preceding statement should be taken.

rules.zh: 不要與 This does not mean that、That is not to say that 或其他相近句型混合；本練習要求 this 和 that。
rules.en: Do not substitute a related expression such as This does not mean that or That is not to say that. This exercise requires both this and that in the target frame.

benefits.zh: 能避免讀者把第一個觀點理解得太遠，減少誤解。
能承認問題的一面，同時表明自己沒有完全否定其他觀點，使論證更平衡。
benefits.en: It makes an argument more balanced.

benefits.zh: 能避免使用 always、never、every 和 completely 等過於絕對的聲稱。
benefits.en: It helps you avoid claims that sound too absolute.

benefits.zh: 能把一個觀點和必要的限制或澄清連接起來。
benefits.en: It connects an idea with an important qualification.

benefits.zh: 適合討論、作文、簡報和其他需要處理複雜問題的場合。
benefits.en: It is useful in discussions, essays and presentations.

en: Rewrite each sentence or pair of sentences using this is not to say that + clause.
Preserve the original meaning, tense, modality and degree of certainty.
The fixed expression may appear after a full stop, semicolon, conjunction, introductory clause or dash.

zh: 使用 this is not to say that + clause 改寫以下句子或句子組合。
保留原句的意思、時態、情態和肯定程度。
固定句型可放在句號、分號、連接詞、引導子句或破折號後。
